description: Deep Frontier new-game setup of the built-in Canyon map: a narrow river canyon between high stepped rims. Two Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites lie on the low benches of the canyon floor (north-west and just south-west of the start), two Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites on the western rim, sandstone and limestone outcrops beside their pits north of the start, five Human Record Caches by the rim ruins, and the launch pad on the north-east rim; no 20x15 reactor footprint exists on this map.

unmet.reason: No bank qualifies for Gatherer Flag shore fishing in the saved water: the clean water is at most 0.34 deep (ShoreFishingSpec MinimumDepth 0.5, contamination at most 0.01), and every one of the 132 water cells at least 0.5 deep is badwater (contamination 1.0). The first FreshFish needs a clean reach dammed deeper by the player.

No flat, dry, free 20x15 footprint exists at any level: wherever a flat strip reaches 20 cells it is at most 12 wide (12x21 on the canyon floor, levels 2-3), and the largest flat rectangle with both sides at least 15 is 17x15 (level 2); the canyon floor is cut by the river and the rims are stepped terraces.
